--LINKMYROWDATA --LINKDETAILLIST(KEEWAYZUP1010X,700,{0},{1},{2},{3},{4}) --LINKDATAMINEOVERVIEW,H,60,AUTOREFRESH DECLARE @LANX3 VARCHAR(30) = '#LINKFUNC.GETLANX3#'; DECLARE @FCY VARCHAR(10)='{0}'; DECLARE @POHNUM VARCHAR(30)='%{1}%'; DECLARE @BPS NVARCHAR(100)=N'%{3}%'; DECLARE @ITM NVARCHAR(100)=N'%{4}%';
SELECT TOP 100 Q.POHNUM_0 AS 采购单号 ,Q.POPLIN_0 AS 行号 ,R.BPSNUM_0 AS 供应商 ,Iif(BPS.BPSSHO_0 = '', BPS.BPSNAM_0, BPS.BPSSHO_0) AS 供应商名称 ,Q.ITMREF_0 AS 产品编码 --,#LC.X3ERP#GetITMDES(ITM.ITMREF_0, @LAN) AS 产品名称 ,ISNULL(L1.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES1_0) AS 产品描述1 ,ISNULL(L2.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES2_0) AS 产品描述2 ,Cast(Q.QTYUOM_0 AS REAL) AS 订单数量 ,Q.UOM_0 AS 单位 ,Cast(Isnull(Q.RCPQTYPUU_0, 0) AS REAL) AS 已收数量 ,Cast(Isnull(A.RECQTY, 0) AS REAL) AS 已收未提交 ,Cast(Q.QTYUOM_0 - Q.RCPQTYPUU_0 AS REAL) AS 未收数量 ,Cast(Q.QTYUOM_0 - Q.RCPQTYPUU_0 - Isnull(A.RECQTY, 0) AS REAL) AS 需收数量 ,ITF.DEFLOC_0 AS 默认收货库位 ,Iif(ITM.SERMGTCOD_0 = 3, '1', '') AS 默认收货数量 ,CASE WHEN ITF.QUAFLG_0 = 1 OR ITF.QUAFLG_0 = 0 THEN 'A' ELSE 'Q' END AS 收货状态 ,Q.PRHFCY_0 AS 收货地点 ,CASE WHEN ( Isnull(A.RECQTY, 0) ) > 0 THEN 'E02' WHEN ( Q.QTYUOM_0 - Q.RCPQTYPUU_0 ) > 0 AND ( Q.QTYUOM_0 - Q.RCPQTYPUU_0 ) < Q.QTYUOM_0 THEN 'A02' ELSE 'C01' END AS ROW_BACKCOLOR2 ,Iif(ITM.SERMGTCOD_0 = 3, 'required', '') AS REQFLG ,Iif(ITM.SERMGTCOD_0 = 3, '', 'mui-hidden') AS HIDFLG ,'{5}' 过账日期 ,Q.POHNUM_0 + Cast(Q.POPLIN_0 AS VARCHAR) id ,CASE WHEN ITF.YLOTCAN_0<>2 AND ITM.LOTMGTCOD_0>1 THEN '*' ELSE '' END LOTMGT ,CASE WHEN ITM.LOTMGTCOD_0 > 1 AND ITF.YLOTCAN_0<>2 THEN N'lang:{zh:批次号管理,en:Batch Management,de:Chargenverwaltung}' ELSE '' END LOTFLG ,CASE WHEN SERMGTCOD_0 =3 THEN N'lang:{zh:序列号管理,en:Serial Number Management,de:Seriennummernverwaltung}' ELSE '' END SERFLG FROM PORDER R INNER JOIN PORDERQ Q ON R.POHNUM_0 = Q.POHNUM_0 INNER JOIN PORDERP P ON P.POHNUM_0 = Q.POHNUM_0 AND P.POPLIN_0 = Q.POPLIN_0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT POHNUM_0 ,POPLIN_0 ,Sum(QTYPCU_0) RECQTY FROM XWSPTH WHERE RPFLG_0 <> 3 AND PKORI_0 = 'POH' GROUP BY POHNUM_0 ,POPLIN_0) A ON A.POHNUM_0 = Q.POHNUM_0 AND A.POPLIN_0 = Q.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = Q.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN1 L1 ON L1.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND L1.LANX3 = @LANX3 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN2 L2 ON L2.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND L2.LANX3 = @LANX3 INNER JOIN ITMFACILIT ITF ON ITF.ITMREF_0 = Q.ITMREF_0 AND ITF.STOFCY_0 = Q.POHFCY_0 INNER JOIN BPSUPPLIER BPS ON BPS.BPSNUM_0 = R.BPSNUM_0 WHERE Q.LINTYP_0 <> 3 AND Q.LINCLEFLG_0 <> 2 AND R.BETCPY_0 <> 2 AND R.POHFCY_0 = @FCY AND Q.POHNUM_0 LIKE @POHNUM AND BPS.BPSNUM_0 + BPS.BPSNAM_0 + BPS.BPSSHO_0 LIKE @BPS AND UPPER(ITM.ITMREF_0+ISNULL(L1.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES1_0) + ISNULL(L2.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES2_0)) LIKE Upper(@ITM) ORDER BY A.RECQTY DESC
